effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] While a Digimon card with [WereGarurumon] in its name is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon gains ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] When this Digimon has [Omnimon] or [Garurumon] in its name (other than [KendoGarurumon]), it gets +1000 DP.
